Subject: Toronto workshop — initial hotel quote + CEO itinerary constraint

Priya —

We have a confirmed workshop with BrightWave for Feb 23–25 in Toronto. BrightWave is pushing for a room block and an on-site executive dinner. Two points I need signoff on before I ask Redwood Travel to finalize:

1) Hotel block cost: attached is the hotel quote (hotel_block_quote_v3.xlsx). The per-night group rate is CAD 420, which is above our standard per-night cap for enterprise onsite (policy cap: CAD 300). The total incremental cost for the group block compared to using our preferred properties is ~CAD 12,800.

2) Last-minute flight upgrade request: BrightWave confirmed the CEO will arrive late evening on Feb 22 and requests a refundable exit flight in business-class for schedule flexibility. Upgrade delta for one return flight (SFO–YYZ) is ~USD 1,450.

Proposal: approve a one-time policy variance to allow the hotel block at the quoted rate and the CEO flight upgrade, charged to charge code 4291 (BrightWave event). If you agree, can we ask Redwood Travel to hold the rooms for 72 hours and provisionally reserve the upgrade?

Attachments: [Attachment: hotel_block_quote_v3.xlsx], [Attachment: provisional_itinerary_v2.pdf]

Thanks —
Marcus

Thanks Marcus —

A few clarifying items before I can route this for final finance signoff:

- Alternate property estimate (preferred list): CAD 280/night average

I reviewed Marcus's breakdown. Given the strategic nature of the BrightWave pilot (deal pipeline: DEAL-4291) I'm comfortable approving a single variance on the hotel block and the one-time refundable CEO upgrade under two conditions:

1) Use charge code 4291 and capture all invoices under the event line item.
